meaning:
πλέκω
[in LXX: Exo.28:14 (עֲבֹת), Isa.28:5 (צְפִירָה)* ;]
to plait, twist, weave: Mat.27:29, Mrk.15:17, Jhn.19:2.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of…
They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.
